scope: One fresh, unattended, proxy-free full v2 API benchmark of the same frozen 100 targets after confirmed renderer-crash recovery and bounded failed-response diagnostics. Four HTTP workers, no client retries, no hosted calls.
changes: Observe Page crash events; type PAGE_CRASHED only after that event, without overriding explicit deadline/cancellation failures. Do not infer a crash from a driver error phrase.

Require the observed crash flag, matching owner boot, one closed stateless page and original deadline before the existing one-alternate opt-in policy. Retained sessions and actions remain ineligible; service-internal crash retries are not added.

Preserve bounded engine/network/document receipts through LocalBrowserTransportError serialization and the HTTP error response. Keep both known failed attempts; keep only known primary completion and mark outcomeUnknown after an unconfirmed alternate.
Copy only recognized bounded document fields; sanitize diagnostic URLs by dropping user information, query and fragment. Diagnostics do not change generic BROWSER_ERROR replay eligibility.

pacing.limit: Slot reservation precedes fetch. Observed gaps are retained; configuration is not an exact dispatch floor.

recentFailedRequests: Peer failed to perform TLS handshake: The TLS connection was non-properly terminated.

socketThrottling.interpretation: Kernel memory.events sock_throttled counts socket throttling. Nonzero events are a resource caveat, not proof of an origin/WAF cause or measured latency effect. No cap, concurrency, retry or kernel setting was changed during the run.

remainingWork: Hosted parity and reliable coverage remain unproven; historical hosted reference is 82/100 and was not refreshed.
Investigate observed non-proper TLS termination and unconfirmed alternate completion separately; do not broaden crash/network matching from error prose.
Separate missing marker/markup-only extraction, verification, origin denial, geography/rate-limit and resource causes using retained evidence; no vendor-wide bypass rate or extraction F1 is inferred.

research.finding: A Page crash event identifies a crashed renderer; ongoing and later page operations can fail. Event proof avoids treating arbitrary operation failures as crashes.
Socket-throttling events are separate from OOM and memory.max events; their count does not establish a failed-target cause.
